title: Learn Release Management
tagline: Ship on schedule — with risk controlled and rollback ready
description: A three-level curriculum for release managers — coordinating versioned deliveries, change control, environments, and communication so teams ship predictably without surprise downtime.
prerequisites: Familiarity with how software is built and deployed (CI/CD at a high level)
Comfort coordinating across engineering, QA, and product
Willingness to write clear runbooks and status updates

levels.title: Release Basics
levels.goal: Coordinate a simple release with a checklist, owners, and clear status

topics.title: What a release is
items: Hotfix vs. scheduled vs. continuous release

topics.title: Roles & RACI
items: Release manager vs. eng lead vs. QA vs. product
Approvers and on-call during a window
Single source of truth for go/no-go

topics.title: Checklists
items: Pre-release, deploy, verify, and post-release steps
Rollback criteria written before you ship

topics.title: Tracking & CI
items: Reading CI green/red as a gate

projects: Release checklist + comms templates for a web app deploy
Mock release train: cut scope, assign owners, run a dry tabletop
Changelog and semver for 5 sample merged PRs
Rollback decision tree for a failed deploy

levels.title: Controlled Delivery
levels.goal: Run multi-service releases with change control, flags, and environment promotion

topics.title: CAB & change records
items: Audit trail that satisfies ops and compliance

topics.title: Environment promotion
items: Config and secret differences across envs

topics.title: Progressive delivery
items: Kill switches and fast disable paths

topics.title: Trains & calendars
items: Metrics: lead time, change fail rate, MTTR

projects: Multi-service release plan with ordered migrations and flags
Canary runbook with success metrics and abort criteria
Change record pack for a CAB-style review
Release calendar for a quarter with freeze windows

levels.title: Release at Scale
levels.goal: Design org-wide release policy, improve DORA metrics, and lead high-risk launches

topics.title: Release governance
items: Org standards for tags, artifacts, and approvals
Self-service release paths vs. gated paths

topics.title: Platform partnership
items: CI/CD and CD tooling ownership boundaries

topics.title: Major events
items: Launch war rooms and executive briefings

topics.title: Continuous improvement
items: Release retros and defect escape analysis
Improving DORA without gaming the metrics

topics.title: Influence under pressure
items: Saying no to unsafe scope late in the freeze
Aligning product urgency with operational risk

projects: Org release policy + RACI adopted by 2+ teams
Major launch runbook (war room, flags, hypercare)
Automation proposal that removes a manual release step
